description: Checks whether a live database (url) or a schema dump (schemaSql) has drifted from the ERD's physical model. Errors: missing/extra tables and columns, PK/FK/NOT NULL mismatches. Warnings (strict promotes to errors): type/unique/auto-increment representation differences. Read-only; the database URL never leaves this process. Pro plan required; requires login.

ignore.description: Table name globs to ignore on the DB side, e.g. flyway_*

schemaSql.description: Schema dump text, e.g. pg_dump -s output

source.description: Target ERD — exactly one of a local file ({file}) or a server ERD ({erdId})

url.description: postgres:// or mysql:// URL (exactly one of url/schemaSql)

name: check_db_drift
